text:
Type: square extendable dining table
Use: dining, seating more guests when extended; dining room, kitchen
Style: traditional, contemporary, classic
Materials: wood veneer with a brown-black stain, pull-out extension leaves
Colors: dark brown-black
Shape: square top with straight edges, deep apron hiding pull-out leaves at both ends, four sturdy square legs, solid and grounded, medium visual weight
Feel: sturdy, serious, warm, dependable
Goes with: dark or white upholstered chairs, light walls, warm wood floors; classic or modern dining rooms and family kitchens
